messages.subject: Independent technical review - Caldera CMS-1 cure-cycle evidence
messages.plaintextBody:
Dr Lyle,

Further to our call, we confirm Halstead's instruction for Lyle Forsyth Associates to conduct an independent review of the cure-cycle conformance evidence and first-article certification packs for shipsets CMS1-0041 to CMS1-0058. The shipsets are quarantined. Please proceed entirely independently and report your findings without regard to any other matter.

Grace Underwood
Halstead Aerospace Limited

messages.subject: RE: Independent technical review - Caldera CMS-1 cure-cycle evidence
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Grace,

Our review is complete and the summary report follows under separate cover. In short: nine of the eighteen shipsets show a documentary discrepancy between the certification pack and the raw datalogger traces, arising from manual transcription rather than falsification; witness-panel coupon testing is within specification. We recommend re-issuing the packs from the validated export and notifying Caldera. The original concern was well-founded as to the documentation and was raised appropriately.

Dr Margaret Lyle
Lyle Forsyth Associates
